# ghpm: birds eye view

> High-level project capacity, workload distribution, and active backlog across GitHub repositories by Asifdotexe.

ghpm is a serverless, static GitHub project management dashboard. It visualizes capacity, workload distribution, and open issues across repositories with minimal GitHub dark-mode aesthetics, RemoCN typography, and Monocharts.

## Core Features
- Birds-eye view of repository workload and backlog concentration
- Workload tier distribution (Clear, Light, Moderate, Heavy)
- Filterable repository matrix with search and label filtering
- Serverless static deployment via GitHub Actions to GitHub Pages

## URLs
- [Live Dashboard](https://asifdotexe.github.io/ghpm/): Interactive dashboard interface
- [Source Code](https://github.com/Asifdotexe/ghpm): Repository code, data pipeline, and automation
- [Dataset](https://asifdotexe.github.io/ghpm/data/final/dashboard_data.json): Aggregated repository and backlog issue dataset
- [Author](https://github.com/Asifdotexe): Asifdotexe profile
